_notes: OpenCV HSV: H 0-179, S 0-255, V 0-255. Grid size comes from game.json (cols/rows). Tuned live on /debug. Pixel sizes are in the warped card (warp). detect runs on a copy with long side 640: approxEpsilon is a fraction of the outline length, kept small so a corner hidden by ink survives and is rebuilt by extending the sides; maxAreaFraction rejects outlines that fill the photo; minContrast is the grey-level step from table to paper (median inside the card minus a ring outside it; each side must show half of it); insetPx crops the card rim after warping. normalize: flatFieldKernel is the closing size that estimates the bare paper and must be wider than any filled ink area; clahe is off because it lifts large black areas above solid vMax. colors.*.coverage is the share of a tile the mask must cover; a line split between two neighbouring tiles counts once, in the fuller tile. colors.solid.fillOutlines fills shapes drawn as outlines (closePx bridges gaps in the line first; enclosed areas over maxFillFraction of the card are ignored). Blue or red pixels never count as black ink. colors.hazard has a middle hue band (11-16) for red marker that photographs orange-ish; it needs vMin 130 because black pen under warm light is dark brown in that hue band.
